axes.concept: Nudos: latex bands link people to the tools they may use; the soft valve is the shared product-world signature.
axes.layout: Asymmetric tension rig: sticky 38% identity rail and 62% continuous working column. Account rows stretch between two rounded anchors; phone stacks identity, navigation and rows.
axes.navigation: Left peg-shaped spool buttons for Personas, Roles and Mi cuenta; selected peg tilts. Account menu stays in the masthead; form and destructive actions use modal confirmations.
axes.typography: Embedded Rounded Mplus 1c ExtraBold, 43–72px tightly set display; embedded Adwaita Sans for 13–17px controls and data. Rounded letterforms echo inflated latex without a geometric SaaS grotesk.
axes.density: Generous 38px form inset, 22px people-band inset and 17px row gaps. Long low bands expose all six account facts; no KPI or equal-card dashboard.
axes.components: Real shadcn Button, Input and Skeleton; Animate UI checkbox and Base UI modal/alert-dialog primitives. Custom latex loop SVG, compressed action surfaces, band-shaped account rows and grouped permission selector.
axes.colour: Proposal: pale pool blue #dfeded and deep petrol #075e60, with latex yellow #f7ce45 for material anchors only. Dark: #10282b/#193b3e with mint #8ce0d5 controls. Text #123b3f or #f0f9f7; no purple, cream/terracotta or shared default accent.
axes.motion: Elastic tension grammar, cubic-bezier(.22,1.35,.55,1), expressive 680ms composition and 190ms controls: stretched-band entry, knot torsion, display compression, peg seating, plug engagement, error pressure release, success seal press, empty rocking, hover lift/press squash and profile-driven spring dragging. Natural 440/160ms; subtle 240/120ms. Reduced motion and still=1 settle immediately.
